notes: A session that is not the pending run's driver, writing ordinary source outside that run. The gate binds the session that asked it and the run's own task directory; an unrelated session elsewhere in the same working directory is what the block was never for, so this must allow. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
